description: Assertions a verified migration must satisfy on the historical baseline. Evaluated on the trial database after the migration attempt; each query runs in its own savepoint so a failing probe never taints the next one.

assertions.name: no_null_customer_id
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NULL
assertions.why: the new code assumes every order has an owner

assertions.name: payments_order_id_unique
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT order_id) FROM payments
assertions.why: one payment per order is the new invariant

assertions.name: not_null_constraint_present
assertions.sql: SELECT is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'orders' AND column_name = 'customer_id'
assertions.why: the constraint, not just the data, must be in place

assertions.name: unique_constraint_present
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_payments_order_id'

assertions.name: orders_row_count_preserved
assertions.why: backfill must not drop or invent orders

assertions.name: payments_preserved_incl_archive
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM payments) + (SELECT count(*) FROM payments_dedup_archive)

assertions.name: sentinel_rows_flagged_for_follow_up
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders_backfill_audit WHERE source = 'sentinel'
assertions.why: 17 orders had no recoverable owner; they are flagged, not hidden

assertions.name: old_worker_compat_insert
assertions.sql: INSERT INTO orders(order_id, amount_cents, status, created_at) VALUES (9999999, 100, 'new', now())
assertions.why: workers still on the old code omit customer_id during the rollout window; the insert must still succeed

assertions.name: new_code_insert
assertions.sql: INSERT INTO orders(order_id, customer_id, amount_cents, status, created_at) VALUES (9999998, 42, 100, 'new', now())

assertions.name: duplicate_payment_now_rejected
assertions.sql: INSERT INTO payments(payment_id, order_id, amount_cents, paid_at) VALUES (99999, 1, 100, now()), (99998, 1, 100, now())
assertions.why: the new invariant must be enforced by the database, not only by the code
